caption: The miner fills the block highest fee rate first: T2 at 30 sat/byte, then T1 at 20, then T3 at 10 — even though T3's 15000 satoshi is the biggest total fee. The finished block is 1750 bytes carrying 30000 satoshi, about 17.14 sat/byte.

spec.title: Miner orders by fee rate (worked example)
spec.aria: Three transactions T2 (500 bytes), T1 (250 bytes) and T3 (1000 bytes) are placed into one 1750-byte block in the order of their fee rates 30, 20 and 10 satoshi per byte, giving 30000 satoshi in total.
